generic.Defined scope/population: Every damage element in the claimant demand letter on this claim is assessed for support and reasonableness.
generic.In-scope period: From receipt of the demand letter until the reasonableness conclusion is recorded on the demand activity.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Demand amount, supported amount, variance percentage and reasonableness conclusion are set in ClaimCenter.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Supported special damages total ties to the bills, wage statements and estimates held in the claim file.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Demand letter and evaluation note are stored in the claim repository with receipt and authoring dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unsupported or duplicated damage elements are itemised in the evaluation note with the action taken on each.
generic.Test population: All claimant demands received on the claim during the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any demand lacks an evaluation note showing demanded, supported and variance figures.
generic.Exception handling path: Unsupported demand elements are itemised and returned to claimant counsel as a written counter position.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: A demand is judged reasonable only when every special damage ties to a supporting document in the file.
generic.Evidence location: Demand activity and evaluation note in Guidewire ClaimCenter plus the demand letter in the claim repository.

steps.title: Open the demand letter in the ClaimCenter claim documents tab
sop: Locate the demand letter in the claim documents tab and confirm it is the latest version received
Capture the demanded amount into the Demand field on the claim
Record the demand receipt date and any response deadline stated in the letter
Done when the demanded amount and deadline are captured on the claim
verify: Re-open the claim and confirm the Demand field is populated and non-zero
Pass when the captured demand amount equals the amount stated in the letter

steps.title: Tie each claimed special damage to a source document in the claim repository
sop: List each special damage element claimed (medical, wage loss, property, out of pocket)
Locate the supporting bill, wage statement or repair estimate for each element in the claim repository
Record the supported amount for each element and note any element with no supporting document
Done when every claimed special damage carries a supported amount or an unsupported flag
verify: Total the supported amounts and compare to the specials claimed in the demand
Pass when each special damage line shows either a document reference or an unsupported flag

steps.title: Compare demanded general damages to the ClaimCenter claim valuation
sop: Read the current general damages figure from the claim valuation on the file
Subtract the valuation figure from the demanded general damages and compute the variance percentage
Record the variance percentage on the demand evaluation note
Done when the variance between demand and valuation is computed and recorded
verify: Recompute the variance from the two recorded figures
Pass when the recorded variance percentage matches the demanded and valuation figures on file

steps.title: Flag unsupported or duplicated damage elements in the ClaimCenter evaluation note
sop: Identify damage elements that are unsupported, duplicated across bills, or already paid
Write each flagged element into the evaluation note with the reason it is rejected or reduced
State the reduction applied to the supported amount for each flagged element
Done when every flagged element carries a written reason and a reduction amount
verify: Read the evaluation note and confirm each flagged element names its evidentiary defect
Pass when no flagged element is left without a documented disposition

steps.title: Record the written reasonableness conclusion on the ClaimCenter demand activity
sop: Select the conclusion of reasonable, inflated or unsupported for the demand as a whole
State the demanded amount, the supported amount and the variance in the conclusion text
Note the recommended response position that follows from the conclusion
Done when the reasonableness conclusion is saved on the demand activity
verify: Confirm the demand activity carries one of the three permitted conclusions
Pass when the conclusion text cites demanded, supported and variance figures

steps.title: File the demand evaluation evidence in the claim document repository
sop: Store the demand letter and the evaluation note against the claim in the document repository
Index both documents with the claim number and the demand receipt date
Link the stored documents to the demand activity so they retrieve together
Done when the demand evidence is stored, indexed and linked to the activity
verify: Search the repository by claim number and confirm both documents return
Pass when the demand evaluation note is retrievable and dated

generic.Defined scope/population: All liability and damages inputs on this claim that feed the low, likely and high exposure figures.
generic.In-scope period: From completion of the damages evaluation until the exposure range is recorded on the worksheet.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Liability percentage, specials subtotal, general damages basis and low likely high figures are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: The specials subtotal on the worksheet equals the sum of medical, wage loss and property amounts in the file.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The exposure worksheet is saved against the claim with the author and calculation date recorded.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Inputs that are estimated rather than documented are marked as assumptions with the basis stated.
generic.Test population: All open claims where an exposure range has been calculated in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any of the low, likely or high figures is blank or carries no documented basis.
generic.Exception handling path: A high-end figure above the current total incurred triggers a reserve change request before negotiation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The range is accepted when each figure names the liability weighting and damages source used.
generic.Evidence location: Exposure worksheet on the claim in Guidewire ClaimCenter with source bills in the claim repository.

steps.title: Enter the liability assessment percentage on the ClaimCenter exposure worksheet
sop: Read the liability determination and comparative fault percentage from the claim file
Enter the percentage that will weight the exposure calculation on the worksheet
Note the evidence supporting the percentage such as the police report or witness statements
Done when the liability weighting and its evidentiary basis are recorded
verify: Confirm the worksheet liability percentage matches the liability determination note
Pass when the percentage is populated and traceable to a file document

steps.title: Sum medical, wage-loss and property specials from the claim repository
sop: Total the repriced medical bills held on the claim
Add certified wage loss and documented property damage amounts
Record the specials subtotal on the exposure worksheet with the count of documents used
Done when the specials subtotal is recorded with its document count
verify: Recompute the subtotal from the individual amounts in the file
Pass when the worksheet subtotal equals the sum of the underlying documents

steps.title: Apply the general damages multiplier or jurisdiction verdict range in ClaimCenter
sop: Select the multiplier or the jurisdiction verdict range appropriate to the injury severity
Apply it to the specials subtotal or the injury profile and record the resulting figure
Record the source of the multiplier or verdict data used
Done when the general damages figure and its source are recorded
verify: Confirm the recorded source names a verdict database, jury range or approved multiplier table
Pass when the general damages figure carries a named source

steps.title: Record low, likely and high exposure figures on the exposure worksheet
sop: Apply the liability weighting to the specials plus general damages to derive the likely figure
Derive the low and high figures from best and worst case liability and damages outcomes
Enter all three figures on the worksheet with a one line basis for each
Done when all three exposure figures are populated with a stated basis
verify: Confirm low is less than or equal to likely and likely is less than or equal to high
Pass when the three figures are ordered correctly and each carries a basis

steps.title: Compare the high-end figure to total incurred reserve in ClaimCenter
sop: Read the current total incurred reserve on the affected exposure
Compare it to the high exposure figure and record the shortfall or headroom
Raise a reserve change request where the high figure exceeds total incurred
Done when the comparison is recorded and any reserve request is raised
verify: Confirm the worksheet shows the reserve comparison result
Pass when any shortfall has an open reserve change request attached

steps.title: File the completed exposure worksheet against the claim in ClaimCenter
sop: Attach the completed worksheet to the claim and index it as an exposure evaluation
Record the calculation date and the author on the document
Link the worksheet to the settlement strategy note so both retrieve together
Done when the worksheet is attached, dated and linked
verify: Retrieve the worksheet from the claim documents view
Pass when the stored worksheet shows author and calculation date

generic.Defined scope/population: All claims in suit where defense counsel input on litigation risk and settlement value is required.
generic.In-scope period: From counsel assignment until the written case evaluation is filed and the reserve is reviewed.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Counsel name, panel status, evaluation date and recommended settlement range are recorded on the matter.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: The legal expense reserve equals or exceeds the defense cost estimate given in counsel evaluation.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The counsel evaluation letter is filed against the litigation matter with its issue date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Use of non-panel counsel is recorded with the approval and reason on the litigation matter.
generic.Test population: All litigated claims with a settlement evaluation requested in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a litigated claim carries no dated written case evaluation from assigned counsel.
generic.Exception handling path: A cost estimate above the current legal reserve triggers a reserve increase before further negotiation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The evaluation is accepted when it covers liability, verdict range and defense cost estimate.
generic.Evidence location: Litigation matter in Guidewire ClaimCenter with the evaluation letter in the claim repository.

steps.title: Confirm assigned defense counsel is on the approved panel in ClaimCenter
sop: Open the litigation matter and read the assigned defense counsel record
Check the firm against the approved panel list before requesting an evaluation
Record the approval reference where non-panel counsel is used
Done when panel status is confirmed and recorded on the matter
verify: Confirm the matter shows a panel firm or a recorded non-panel approval
Pass when counsel panel status is explicit on the litigation matter

steps.title: Request a written case evaluation from counsel through the ClaimCenter matter activity
sop: Raise an evaluation request activity naming the required content and due date
Ask for liability assessment, verdict range and defense cost to trial estimate
Provide counsel with the current damages evaluation and coverage position
Done when the request activity is issued with a due date
verify: Confirm the open request states the three required content elements
Pass when the request activity exists with an assigned due date

steps.title: Attach the counsel evaluation letter to the claim repository
sop: Import the received evaluation letter into the claim document repository
Index it as a defense counsel case evaluation with its letter date
Link the document to the litigation matter on the claim
Done when the evaluation is stored, dated and linked to the matter
verify: Open the litigation matter documents and locate the evaluation
Pass when the evaluation letter is present and carries a date

steps.title: Record counsel recommended settlement range in the ClaimCenter strategy note
sop: Read the recommended settlement range and verdict range from the evaluation
Record both into the negotiation strategy note with the counsel name and date
Note where counsel view differs from the internal exposure worksheet
Done when the counsel range is recorded in the strategy note
verify: Compare the recorded range against the figures in the evaluation letter
Pass when the strategy note range matches the counsel letter

steps.title: Update the legal expense reserve in ClaimCenter against the defense cost estimate
sop: Compare counsel defense cost to trial estimate with the current legal expense reserve
Raise a reserve change to the estimate where the current reserve is lower
Record the counsel estimate as the rationale on the reserve change
Done when the legal expense reserve covers the counsel cost estimate
verify: Read the expense reserve after the change and compare to the estimate
Pass when the legal expense reserve is at or above the counsel estimate

steps.title: Diary the litigation risk position for review in ClaimCenter
sop: Set a diary date tied to the next litigation milestone such as mediation or trial setting
Note the events that would require a refreshed counsel evaluation
Assign the diary to the handler owning the negotiation
Done when the review diary is set and assigned
verify: Confirm an open diary activity exists on the litigation matter
Pass when the diary date precedes the next litigation milestone

generic.Defined scope/population: Every proposed settlement value on the claim that must be matched to an authority tier before an offer.
generic.In-scope period: From completion of the exposure worksheet until the required approver level is recorded.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Proposed settlement value, handler limit, authority tier and required approver name are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: The proposed value sits inside the amount band of the identified authority tier with no gap.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The authority request activity records the determination with its creation timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Policy limits settlements are flagged and routed to the officer tier with the reason recorded.
generic.Test population: All claims where a settlement authority determination was made in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the recorded authority tier does not cover the proposed settlement amount.
generic.Exception handling path: A proposed value above the handler limit blocks any offer until the higher tier is engaged.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The determination is accepted when the tier, approver name and policy limits flag are all recorded.
generic.Evidence location: Authority request activity and settlement record in Guidewire ClaimCenter.

steps.title: Read the proposed settlement value from the ClaimCenter exposure worksheet
sop: Open the exposure worksheet and read the likely and high settlement figures
Select the value that will be used as the proposed settlement amount
Record that value on the authority request activity
Done when the proposed settlement value is recorded
verify: Compare the recorded value against the worksheet figures
Pass when the proposed value is populated and traceable to the worksheet

steps.title: Compare the proposed value to the handler authority limit in ClaimCenter
sop: Read the current handler authority limit from the user authority record
Compare it to the proposed settlement value and record the difference
Mark the claim as over-authority where the value exceeds the handler limit
Done when the comparison result is recorded on the request
verify: Confirm the request shows either within-authority or over-authority
Pass when the comparison result is explicit on the activity

steps.title: Identify the authority tier covering the proposed amount in ClaimCenter
sop: Match the proposed amount to the handler, supervisor, manager or officer band
Select the lowest tier whose limit fully covers the proposed amount
Record the selected tier on the authority request activity
Done when the covering authority tier is recorded
verify: Check the proposed amount falls inside the recorded tier band
Pass when the tier limit is at or above the proposed amount

steps.title: Flag policy-limits settlements on the ClaimCenter claim
sop: Read the applicable coverage limit and prior payments from the claim financials
Set the policy-limits indicator where the proposed value reaches the remaining limit
Record the limit figure relied on alongside the indicator
Done when the policy-limits status is set and evidenced
verify: Confirm the indicator state matches the limit and proposed value figures
Pass when a policy-limits proposal carries the indicator set

steps.title: Record the required approver level and name on the ClaimCenter authority request
sop: Identify the named individual holding the required tier limit
Enter the approver level and name on the authority request activity
Note any second approval required by the policy-limits flag
Done when the approver level and name are recorded
verify: Read the request and confirm both approver level and name are present
Pass when the named approver holds the recorded tier

steps.title: Confirm no offer above the handler limit has been extended in ClaimCenter
sop: Review the offer log for offers extended before the authority determination
Compare each logged offer amount to the handler limit in force on its date
Escalate immediately where an offer exceeded the limit in force
Done when the offer history is confirmed clear or the breach is escalated
verify: Recheck the offer log against the handler limit history
Pass when no logged offer exceeds the limit in force on its own date

generic.Defined scope/population: The negotiation approach and opening offer rationale for this claim ahead of first contact.
generic.In-scope period: From completion of the evaluation until the approach is filed before the first offer date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Opening offer amount, source evaluation figure, concession plan and counterparty profile are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: The opening offer traces to a named component of the recorded claim evaluation.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The negotiation approach document is stored in OpenText with an author and version date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: An opening offer at or below nuisance value is recorded with a written justification.
generic.Test population: All claims entering negotiation in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the approach document is dated after the first offer was extended.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing evaluation support blocks the opening offer until the evaluation figure is completed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The approach is accepted when offer amount, concession rounds and evidence points are all documented.
generic.Evidence location: Negotiation strategy note in Guidewire ClaimCenter with the approach document in OpenText.

steps.title: Record the opening offer amount and its source figure in ClaimCenter
sop: Select the evaluation component the opening offer derives from
Enter the opening offer amount on the negotiation strategy note
State the evaluation figure and the discount applied to reach the opening number
Done when the opening offer and its source figure are recorded
verify: Trace the opening offer back to the evaluation component named
Pass when the opening offer maps to a recorded evaluation figure

steps.title: Document the planned concession pattern across negotiation rounds in OpenText
sop: Set the expected number of rounds and the movement permitted at each round
State the maximum figure the concessions may reach before escalation
Store the concession plan in the approach document in OpenText
Done when the round by round concession plan is documented
verify: Read the plan and confirm each round carries a movement figure
Pass when the final planned figure is at or below the granted authority

steps.title: State the evidentiary points supporting the offer in the ClaimCenter strategy note
sop: List the liability split, IME conclusion, wage records and repricing results to be used
Note which document in the claim file evidences each point
Record the order in which points will be deployed during negotiation
Done when each evidentiary point is listed with its supporting document
verify: Confirm each listed point names a document held on the claim
Pass when no evidentiary point lacks a file reference

steps.title: Note the counterparty profile and communication channel in ClaimCenter
sop: Record whether the counterparty is attorney represented, pro se or an adverse carrier
Record the agreed communication channel and the contact of record
Note any restriction on direct contact where the claimant is represented
Done when counterparty profile and channel are recorded
verify: Confirm the contact of record matches the representation status on the claim
Pass when represented claimants show counsel as the recorded contact

steps.title: Confirm the opening offer clears the nuisance-value threshold in ClaimCenter
sop: Compare the opening offer to the nuisance value threshold for the claim type
Record a written justification where the offer sits at or below the threshold
Adjust the opening offer where no justification can be supported
Done when the offer clears the threshold or carries a justification
verify: Read the strategy note for the threshold comparison result
Pass when a below-threshold offer carries a recorded justification

steps.title: File the approach document in OpenText before the first offer date
sop: Store the finished approach document in OpenText indexed to the claim number
Record the author and the document date on the stored version
Link the stored document to the ClaimCenter negotiation strategy note
Done when the approach document is stored, dated and linked
verify: Compare the document date with the first logged offer date
Pass when the approach document date precedes the first offer date

generic.Defined scope/population: The settlement strategy covering liability, damages, coverage and exposure analysis for this claim.
generic.In-scope period: From completion of the exposure analysis until the strategy note is dated before the first offer.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Liability percentage, target value, authority tier, timing and open value drivers are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Total incurred reserve equals or exceeds the documented target settlement value.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The strategy note carries an author and a date and its supporting documents are attached.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Open items that could move value are listed with an owner and an expected resolution date.
generic.Test population: All claims that reached settlement strategy stage in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the strategy note is dated after the first offer or if reserve is below the target value.
generic.Exception handling path: A reserve below the target value triggers a reserve change request before negotiation opens.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The strategy is accepted when liability, damages, coverage, target and timing are all documented.
generic.Evidence location: Settlement strategy note on the claim in Guidewire ClaimCenter with attachments in the claim repository.

steps.title: Summarise the liability determination in the ClaimCenter strategy note
sop: State the liability decision and the comparative fault percentage relied upon
Cite the investigation documents that support the determination
Note any unresolved liability dispute that could change the percentage
Done when the liability position is summarised with its evidence
verify: Confirm the stated percentage matches the liability determination on file
Pass when the summary cites at least one supporting investigation document

steps.title: Attach the damages evaluation and coverage position from the claim repository
sop: Locate the damages evaluation and the coverage position letter in the claim repository
Attach both to the strategy note as supporting documents
Confirm each attachment is the current version rather than a superseded draft
Done when both supporting documents are attached to the strategy
verify: Open the strategy note attachments list
Pass when both the damages evaluation and coverage position are present

steps.title: State the target value, authority tier and timing in ClaimCenter
sop: Record the target settlement value derived from the exposure worksheet
Record the authority tier that must approve that value
Record the expected time to resolution and the trigger milestones
Done when target value, tier and timing are recorded
verify: Check the target value sits inside the recorded authority tier band
Pass when all three fields are populated and internally consistent

steps.title: List open value drivers on the ClaimCenter strategy note
sop: List outstanding IME, records requests and unknown lien amounts
State the value impact range for each open item
Assign an owner and expected date to each open item
Done when every open value driver has an owner and a date
verify: Read the open items list on the strategy note
Pass when no listed open item lacks an owner or a date

steps.title: Confirm total incurred reserve supports the target value in ClaimCenter
sop: Read total incurred on the affected exposure from the claim financials
Compare it to the documented target settlement value
Raise a reserve change request where the reserve is below the target
Done when the reserve covers the target or a change request is open
verify: Compare the reserve figure with the target value after any change
Pass when total incurred is greater than or equal to the target value

steps.title: Date and file the settlement strategy note in ClaimCenter
sop: Save the strategy note against the claim with the author recorded
Confirm the note date precedes any planned first offer date
Index the note so it retrieves with the exposure worksheet
Done when the strategy note is saved, dated and indexed
verify: Compare the note date with the first offer date in the offer log
Pass when the strategy note date precedes the first offer date

generic.Defined scope/population: All damages elements on the claim covering medical specials, wage loss, future care and general damages.
generic.In-scope period: From receipt of medical and wage documentation until the damages evaluation is recorded.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Medical, wage-loss, future care, impairment and general damages figures each carry a source reference.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: The billed and repriced medical totals reconcile to the individual bills held in the claim repository.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Bills, wage statements and medical reports are stored against the claim with receipt dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Damages elements with no source document are recorded as unsupported with the action taken.
generic.Test population: All bodily injury claims evaluated for damages in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any damages line carries no documented source.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing wage or medical documentation triggers a records request and holds the evaluation open.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The evaluation is accepted when medical, wage-loss and general damages each cite a source.
generic.Evidence location: Damages evaluation on the claim in Guidewire ClaimCenter with bills in the claim repository.

steps.title: Total billed and repriced medical specials in ClaimCenter
sop: List every medical bill held on the claim and total the billed amounts
Record the repriced amount from the bill review result for each provider
Enter billed and repriced totals on the damages evaluation
Done when billed and repriced medical totals are recorded
verify: Recompute the totals from the individual bills in the claim repository
Pass when the evaluation totals equal the sum of the stored bills

steps.title: Record wage loss from the employer wage statement in ClaimCenter
sop: Read the employer wage statement and the certified dates of disability
Compute wage loss for the certified period only
Record the figure with the wage statement reference on the evaluation
Done when the wage-loss figure and its source are recorded
verify: Recompute the wage loss from the rate and certified period
Pass when the recorded figure matches the certified disability period

steps.title: Record future medical or life-care cost estimates in ClaimCenter
sop: Read the treating physician or life care plan projection from the claim repository
Record the future medical or life care cost estimate on the evaluation
Name the report and its author as the source of the estimate
Done when the future cost estimate and its source report are recorded
verify: Confirm the recorded estimate matches the figure in the named report
Pass when the future cost line cites a specific source report

steps.title: Assess permanency and impairment rating from the medical records
sop: Review the medical records and any IME for an impairment rating
Record the rating percentage and the guide edition used
Note the examining physician and the examination date as the rating source
Done when the impairment rating and its source are recorded
verify: Confirm the recorded rating matches the report in the claim repository
Pass when the rating names the examiner and the examination date

steps.title: Record the general damages figure and comparable verdict range in ClaimCenter
sop: Select the comparable verdicts or jurisdiction range for the injury profile
Record the general damages figure derived from that range
Cite the verdict source and the comparables used
Done when the general damages figure and its comparables are recorded
verify: Confirm the general damages figure sits inside the cited verdict range
Pass when the figure names the comparables relied on

steps.title: Flag unsupported damages lines and request the missing records
sop: Identify any damages line with no supporting document in the claim repository
Mark each as unsupported on the evaluation with the missing document named
Raise a records request activity for each missing document
Done when every unsupported line carries a records request
verify: Read the evaluation for unsupported flags and matching requests
Pass when no unsupported line is left without an open records request

generic.Defined scope/population: All settling parties, lienholders and consent requirements attached to this settlement.
generic.In-scope period: From agreement in principle until the party and payee structure is recorded before release drafting.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each party carries a name, role, signing requirement and payee treatment on the claim.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: The party count on the release matches the party list recorded on the claim.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Lien statements and consent evidence are stored in OpenText with their issue dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Parties whose consent is outstanding are logged with the chase action and due date.
generic.Test population: All settlements reaching release drafting in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any required signatory is absent from the recorded party list.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing court or carrier consent holds release issue until the consent is obtained and filed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: The list is accepted when every releasor, lienholder and consenting party is captured with a role.
generic.Evidence location: Parties and lien records on the claim in Guidewire ClaimCenter with documents in OpenText.

steps.title: List every required releasor on the ClaimCenter claim parties view
sop: Add each claimant, spouse for loss of consortium, attorney and guardian to the party list
Record the signing requirement against each party
Confirm the legal name of each party matches an identity document on file
Done when every required signatory is on the party list with a role
verify: Compare the party list to the claimants and dependants named on the claim
Pass when every required signatory appears with a defined role

steps.title: Identify all lienholders and lien amounts in ClaimCenter
sop: Search the file for health plan, Medicare, Medicaid, hospital and workers comp lien notices
Create a lien record for each with the lienholder name and current amount
Attach the supporting lien statement to each record from OpenText
Done when every known lien has a record with an amount and a statement
verify: Compare the lien records to the lien notices held in the claim file
Pass when every lien notice in the file has a matching lien record

steps.title: Confirm court or guardian approval requirements on the ClaimCenter claim
sop: Check whether any claimant is a minor or incapacitated person
Record whether court approval or guardian appointment is required
Raise the approval activity where a requirement exists
Done when the approval requirement is recorded and any activity is raised
verify: Read the claim for the protected claimant indicator and requirement note
Pass when every protected claimant carries an approval requirement record

steps.title: Confirm excess or reinsurance carrier consent requirements in ClaimCenter
sop: Compare the settlement value to the excess attachment point and reinsurance thresholds
Record whether excess carrier or reinsurer consent is required
Raise the consent request where a threshold is met
Done when the consent requirement is recorded and requested where needed
verify: Check the settlement value against the recorded attachment point
Pass when any settlement above the threshold shows a consent request

steps.title: Record the payee and co-payee structure for the settlement draft in ClaimCenter
sop: Define the payee line including claimant, attorney and any direct paid lienholder
Record whether payees are joint or separate on the payment instruction
Confirm the structure matches the agreed lien resolution method
Done when the payee and co-payee structure is recorded
verify: Compare the payee structure to the lien resolution decisions recorded
Pass when every direct paid lienholder appears in the payee structure

steps.title: File the party and consent evidence in OpenText
sop: Store lien statements, consent letters and guardian appointments in OpenText
Index each to the claim number and the party it relates to
Link the stored documents to the matching party or lien record
Done when every party and consent record has its evidence stored and linked
verify: Open each party and lien record and check for a linked document
Pass when no party requiring evidence is missing its document

generic.Defined scope/population: All significant injury or long-tail claims screened against structured-settlement referral criteria.
generic.In-scope period: From damages evaluation completion until the structured settlement indicator is set on the claim.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Structured settlement indicator, screening rationale and referral status are populated on the claim.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Every claim meeting the referral threshold has a matching referral activity raised.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The screening rationale is recorded on the claim with the screening date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Claims that meet criteria but are not referred carry a recorded reason for the exclusion.
generic.Test population: All claims above the severity or value threshold reviewed in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a claim over the referral threshold has no recorded screening rationale.
generic.Exception handling path: Claims meeting criteria are referred to the structured settlement consultant through a referral activity.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Screening is accepted when severity, value and future needs are each addressed in the rationale.
generic.Evidence location: Structured settlement indicator and screening note on the claim in Guidewire ClaimCenter.

steps.title: Check the claim against structured-settlement criteria in ClaimCenter
sop: Read the injury severity, claimant age and claim type from the claim record
Compare them to the structured settlement screening criteria
Record which criteria are met and which are not
Done when each criterion is assessed and recorded
verify: Read the screening note for a per-criterion result
Pass when every screening criterion carries a met or not-met result

steps.title: Compare projected settlement value to the referral threshold in ClaimCenter
sop: Read the projected settlement value from the exposure worksheet
Compare it to the structured settlement referral threshold
Record the comparison result on the screening note
Done when the threshold comparison is recorded
verify: Recheck the projected value against the threshold
Pass when the recorded result matches the projected value

steps.title: Assess future medical and wage-replacement needs from the claim repository
sop: Review the life care plan or treating physician projection held in the claim repository
Note whether ongoing care or income replacement needs exist
Record the need profile supporting periodic payments on the screening note
Done when the future needs assessment is recorded
verify: Confirm the needs assessment cites a document in the claim repository
Pass when the recorded needs profile names its source document

steps.title: Set the structured-settlement candidate indicator on the ClaimCenter claim
sop: Set the candidate indicator to yes or no based on the screening results
Record the rationale text supporting the setting
Record the screening date and the person who performed it
Done when the indicator and rationale are saved on the claim
verify: Read the indicator and rationale on the claim
Pass when the indicator state is consistent with the recorded criteria results

steps.title: Raise the consultant referral activity in ClaimCenter where criteria are met
sop: Create the structured settlement referral activity for candidate claims
Attach the screening note and damages evaluation to the referral
Assign the referral with a due date ahead of the next negotiation
Done when the referral activity is created and assigned
verify: Confirm every candidate claim carries an open or completed referral
Pass when no candidate claim is missing a referral activity

steps.title: Record exclusions and the reason on the ClaimCenter screening note
sop: Identify claims meeting criteria that will not be referred

generic.Required fields populated and valid: Assignee, periodic payment obligation, issuer, signatories and execution dates are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: The signature count on the assignment equals the number of required parties.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Executed release and assignment are stored in OpenText with execution dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Documents executed out of sequence are logged and re-executed where required.
generic.Test population: All structured settlements executed in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the funding payment date precedes the assignment execution date.
generic.Exception handling path: A missing signature blocks funding until the document is fully executed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when release and assignment are executed, consistent and filed before funding.
generic.Evidence location: Executed documents in OpenText linked to the claim in Guidewire ClaimCenter.

steps.title: Confirm release execution timing against the assignment
sop: Read the execution dates on the release and the qualified assignment
Confirm the release is executed before or with the assignment
Re-execute where the sequence is wrong
Done when the execution sequence is confirmed correct
verify: Compare the two execution dates
Pass when the release date is on or before the assignment date

steps.title: Confirm the assignment names assignee, obligation and issuer
sop: Read the assignee, periodic payment obligation and annuity issuer
Compare each with the settlement terms and the annuity quote accepted
Query the assignment where any element is missing
Done when all three elements are confirmed present and correct
verify: Compare the assignment terms with the settlement terms
Pass when assignee, obligation and issuer are all correctly named

steps.title: Confirm claimant, insurer and assignment company have signed
sop: List the parties required to sign the assignment
Confirm a signature is present for each party
Return the document for completion where a signature is missing
Done when every required party has signed
verify: Count the signatures against the required parties
Pass when the signature count equals the required party count

steps.title: Confirm the release does not conflict with the payment schedule
sop: Read the release wording covering payment of the settlement
Compare it with the periodic payment schedule in the assignment
Amend and re-execute where the wording conflicts
Done when release wording and schedule are consistent
verify: Compare release wording with the periodic payment schedule
Pass when no release term conflicts with the payment schedule

steps.title: File the executed release and assignment set in OpenText
sop: Store the executed release and assignment in OpenText
Index both with the claim number and execution dates
Link both to the structured settlement record
Done when both executed documents are stored and linked
verify: Retrieve both from the settlement record links
Pass when both executed documents open from the claim

steps.title: Hold the annuity funding payment until the set is filed
sop: Apply a payment hold on the funding payment until documents are filed
Release the hold only when both executed documents are on file
Record the release of hold with the date and checker
Done when the hold is released against a filed executed set
verify: Compare the funding payment date with the assignment execution date
Pass when the executed assignment is on file before the funding payment

generic.Defined scope/population: The funding payment transferring settlement funds to the annuity issuer for this placement.
generic.In-scope period: From filing of the executed documents until the issuer receipt is filed on the claim.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Payee, funding amount, quote reference, dual approvals and issuer receipt are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: The funding amount equals the accepted annuity quote cost for the placement.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The issuer receipt or policy issuance confirmation is filed with its date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Payments attempted to the claimant rather than the issuer are logged and blocked.
generic.Test population: All annuity funding payments made in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the funding amount differs from the accepted quote or the payee is not the issuer.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing executed documents block the funding payment until they are filed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when documents, payee, amount, dual approval and receipt all check out.
generic.Evidence location: Funding payment in the payment system with the posting in the ERP ledger.

steps.title: Confirm the executed release and assignment are on file before funding
sop: Check the claim for the executed release and qualified assignment
Confirm both are the fully executed versions
Hold the funding payment where either is absent
Done when both executed documents are confirmed on file
verify: Open both documents from the claim
Pass when both executed documents are present before funding

steps.title: Confirm the payee on the funding payment is the annuity issuer
sop: Read the payee on the funding payment instruction
Confirm it is the annuity issuer rather than the claimant
Correct the payee where it names any other party
Done when the payee is confirmed as the issuer
verify: Compare the payee with the issuer named in the assignment
Pass when the funding payee is the annuity issuer

steps.title: Confirm the funding amount equals the accepted quote
sop: Read the accepted annuity quote cost from the quote comparison
Compare it to the funding payment amount
Return the payment for correction where they differ
Done when the funding amount equals the accepted quote
verify: Compare the two amounts directly
Pass when the funding amount equals the accepted annuity quote

steps.title: Apply dual approval to the funding payment
sop: Route the funding payment for two distinct approvals
Confirm neither approver prepared the payment
Capture both approver IDs and timestamps
Done when two distinct approvals are captured
verify: Read the approval block on the funding payment
Pass when two distinct approver IDs are recorded

steps.title: Obtain and file the issuer receipt after funding
sop: Request the issuer receipt or policy issuance confirmation
Store it against the claim with its issue date
Link it to the structured settlement record
Done when the issuer receipt is filed and linked
verify: Retrieve the receipt from the settlement record
Pass when an issuer receipt is on file with a date

steps.title: Confirm the funding payment posts to the ERP ledger
sop: Trace the funding payment into the ERP ledger posting
Confirm the amount and account coding are correct
Record the ledger reference on the claim transaction
Done when the funding payment is traced into the ledger
verify: Compare the ledger posting with the funding payment
Pass when the ledger posting equals the accepted annuity quote amount

generic.Defined scope/population: Claims assessed as structured settlement candidates with a proposed periodic payment schedule.
generic.In-scope period: From damages evaluation until the candidate decision and schedule are recorded on the claim.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Severity threshold result, claimant category, proposed schedule and decision rationale are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: The projected annuity cost plus the cash portion sits within the recorded reserve.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The candidate decision is recorded with the assessor name and decision date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Candidates rejected despite meeting criteria carry a recorded reason.
generic.Test population: All severe injury claims assessed in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a candidate decision is recorded without a proposed payment schedule.
generic.Exception handling path: A reserve short of the projected cost triggers a reserve change before placement.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when threshold, category, schedule and reserve support are all documented.
generic.Evidence location: Structured settlement record on the claim in Guidewire ClaimCenter with data in the repository.

steps.title: Confirm the claim meets the severity and value threshold
sop: Read the injury severity and projected settlement value from the claim
Compare both to the structured settlement thresholds
Record the threshold result on the structured settlement record
Done when the threshold assessment is recorded
verify: Recheck the values against the thresholds
Pass when the recorded result matches the claim values

steps.title: Confirm the claimant category supporting periodic payments
sop: Determine whether the claimant is a minor, incapacitated or catastrophically injured
Record the category on the structured settlement record
Note any court approval implication of the category
Done when the claimant category is recorded
verify: Compare the recorded category with the claimant details
Pass when the category matches the claimant profile on the claim

steps.title: Draft the proposed payment schedule in the claim repository
sop: Draft periodic amounts covering future medical and wage replacement
Include any deferred lump sums and the guaranteed period
Store the draft schedule in the claim repository
Done when the proposed schedule is drafted and stored
verify: Retrieve the draft schedule from the repository
Pass when the schedule covers future medical and income needs

steps.title: Confirm the reserve supports the projected annuity and cash cost
sop: Estimate the annuity cost for the proposed schedule
Add the expected cash portion and compare to the reserve
Raise a reserve change where the reserve is short
Done when the reserve covers the projected total cost
verify: Compare the reserve with the projected total cost
Pass when the reserve is at or above the projected total

steps.title: Record the candidate decision and rationale in ClaimCenter
sop: Record the candidate decision of proceed or decline
State the rationale covering severity, category and needs
Record the assessor name and decision date
Done when decision, rationale and date are recorded
verify: Read the structured settlement record
Pass when the candidate decision and payment schedule are both recorded

steps.title: Raise the placement activity for candidate claims in ClaimCenter
sop: Create the placement activity for claims decided as candidates
Attach the proposed schedule and reserve confirmation
Assign it to the structured settlement owner with a due date
Done when the placement activity is raised and assigned
verify: Confirm candidate claims carry an assigned placement activity
Pass when every candidate claim shows an open placement activity

generic.Defined scope/population: Annuity quotes obtained from approved life markets for the proposed payment schedule.
generic.In-scope period: From consultant engagement until the quote comparison sheet is filed on the claim.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Carrier name, cost, rated age, guaranteed period and financial strength rating are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: The number of quotes obtained meets or exceeds the minimum required by policy.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Quote letters and the comparison sheet are filed with their quote dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Quotes priced on a different schedule are logged and re-requested for comparability.
generic.Test population: All structured settlement placements quoted in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if fewer than the required number of comparable quotes is on file.
generic.Exception handling path: A carrier below the rating threshold is excluded and a further quote is sought.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when quotes are comparable, rated and filed with the comparison sheet.
generic.Evidence location: Quote letters and comparison sheet in the claim repository referenced in ClaimCenter.

steps.title: Request quotes from the minimum number of approved life markets
sop: Identify the minimum number of markets required by policy
Request quotes from that number of approved carriers
Record each request date on the claim
Done when the required number of quote requests is issued
verify: Count the quote requests issued
Pass when the request count meets the policy minimum

steps.title: Confirm every quote is priced on the identical schedule
sop: Compare the payment schedule quoted by each carrier
Confirm amounts, frequency, dates and guarantees are identical
Re-request any quote priced on a different schedule
Done when every quote is priced on the same schedule
verify: Compare the schedules across the quotes
Pass when every quote uses the identical payment schedule

steps.title: Compare cost, rated age and guaranteed period across quotes
sop: Build the comparison sheet with cost, rated age and guarantee per carrier
Note where a rated age materially reduces cost
Record the lowest cost and the preferred quote
Done when the comparison sheet is complete for every quote
verify: Read the comparison sheet for the three data points
Pass when every quote row carries cost, rated age and guarantee

steps.title: Confirm each quoting carrier meets the rating requirement
sop: Read the financial strength rating for each quoting carrier
Compare each to the minimum rating requirement
Exclude carriers below the threshold and note the exclusion
Done when every quote carries a rating check result
verify: Read the rating column on the comparison sheet
Pass when every retained quote meets the minimum rating

steps.title: File the quote letters and comparison sheet in the claim repository
sop: Store every quote letter and the comparison sheet against the claim
Index them with the claim number and quote dates
Link them to the structured settlement record
Done when all quote evidence is stored and linked
verify: Retrieve the quote set from the settlement record
Pass when the comparison and all quote letters retrieve together

steps.title: Record the quote outcome on the ClaimCenter claim
sop: Record the number of quotes received and the cost range
Record the preferred quote reference for carrier selection
Diary the selection decision date
Done when the quote outcome is recorded with a selection diary
verify: Read the recorded quote outcome
Pass when a comparison on one schedule is on file from the required carriers

generic.Defined scope/population: Court approval obtained for structured settlements involving minors or incapacitated claimants.
generic.In-scope period: From identification of a protected claimant until the certified order is filed on the claim.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Approval requirement, petition figures, order terms, guardian details and order date are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Gross settlement less fees, costs and liens equals the net to claimant stated in the petition.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The certified order is stored in OpenText with the entry date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Orders differing from the settlement terms are logged and corrected before payment.
generic.Test population: All protected claimant settlements in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any payment was released before the court order was filed on the claim.
generic.Exception handling path: An order inconsistent with the schedule returns to counsel for an amended order.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when the order matches the settlement amount and the payment schedule.
generic.Evidence location: Certified order in OpenText linked to the claim in Guidewire ClaimCenter.

steps.title: Confirm whether court or guardian approval is required in ClaimCenter
sop: Read the claimant age and capacity status on the claim
Determine whether court approval or guardian appointment is required
Record the requirement on the settlement record
Done when the approval requirement is determined and recorded
verify: Read the claim for the protected claimant flag and requirement
Pass when every protected claimant carries an approval requirement

steps.title: Confirm the petition states gross, fees, costs and net
sop: Read the petition presented to the court
Confirm gross settlement, attorney fees, costs and net to claimant are stated
Query the petition where any figure is absent
Done when all four figures are confirmed present
verify: Recompute net from gross less fees, costs and liens
Pass when the petition figures reconcile to the settlement record

steps.title: Confirm the entered order matches the settlement and schedule
sop: Read the entered court order terms
Compare the amount and structured payment schedule with the settlement
Return to counsel for an amended order where they differ
Done when the order is confirmed consistent with the settlement
verify: Compare the order terms with the settlement record
Pass when the order amount and schedule match the settlement

steps.title: Confirm guardian ad litem appointment and fee award
sop: Check whether a guardian ad litem was appointed
Confirm any fee award is addressed in the order
Record the guardian details and fee on the claim
Done when guardian appointment and fee treatment are recorded
verify: Read the order and the claim guardian record
Pass when any guardian fee award is recorded on the claim

steps.title: File the certified order in OpenText
sop: Store the certified copy of the order in OpenText
Index it with the claim number and the order entry date
Link it to the settlement record on the claim
Done when the certified order is stored, indexed and linked
verify: Retrieve the order from the settlement record
Pass when the certified order opens from the claim

steps.title: Hold payment until the order is on the claim
sop: Apply a payment hold for the protected claimant settlement
Release the hold only once the certified order is filed
Record the hold release date and checker
Done when the hold is released against a filed order
verify: Compare the payment release date with the order filing date
Pass when no payment is released to a protected claimant before the order is filed

generic.Defined scope/population: Structured and cash settlement options presented to the claimant with tax-advantage disclosures.
generic.In-scope period: From receipt of the annuity illustration until the claimant election is recorded on the claim.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Options presented, illustration reference, disclosure text, presentation date and election are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: The illustration total guaranteed payout matches the proposed payment schedule.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The illustration and the election record are stored with their dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Direct presentation to a represented claimant is logged as an exception.
generic.Test population: All structured settlement candidates presented to claimants in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if no written illustration or no recorded election is on file.
generic.Exception handling path: A claimant electing cash returns the claim to standard settlement processing.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when both options, the disclosure and the election are documented.
generic.Evidence location: Illustration in the claim repository with the election recorded in ClaimCenter.

steps.title: Present the cash lump sum alongside the structured option
sop: Prepare the cash lump sum figure and the structured schedule side by side
Present both options to the claimant or counsel
Record which options were presented on the claim
Done when both options are presented and recorded
verify: Read the claim record for the options presented
Pass when both cash and structured options are recorded as presented

steps.title: Provide the written illustration from the claim repository
sop: Obtain the illustration showing periodic amounts, dates and total payout
Send it to the claimant or counsel and store the sent copy
Record the despatch date on the claim
Done when the illustration is provided and stored
verify: Retrieve the stored illustration
Pass when the illustration shows amounts, dates and total guaranteed payout

steps.title: Include the independent advice disclosure
sop: Include the standard disclosure recommending independent tax and legal advice
Confirm the disclosure wording is the approved current version
Store the disclosure with the presentation pack
Done when the approved disclosure is included and stored
verify: Read the presentation pack for the disclosure
Pass when the approved disclosure wording is present

steps.title: Present through the attorney of record where represented
sop: Check the representation status on the claim
Route the presentation through counsel where the claimant is represented
Record the recipient and channel on the claim
Done when the presentation is routed to the correct recipient
verify: Compare the recipient with the representation status
Pass when represented claimants received the pack through counsel

steps.title: Record the claimant election and date in ClaimCenter
sop: Record the option elected by the claimant
Record the date the election was received and the evidencing document
Store the written election in the claim repository
Done when the election, date and evidence are recorded
verify: Read the claim for the election and its date
Pass when the illustration and the recorded election are both on file

steps.title: Route the claim by the recorded election in ClaimCenter
sop: Continue to placement where the structured option is elected
Return the claim to standard settlement where cash is elected
Record the routing decision on the structured settlement record
Done when the claim is routed by the recorded election
verify: Compare the routing with the recorded election
Pass when the claim path matches the claimant election

generic.Defined scope/population: The recurring annuity payment obligation booked into the administration system for this claim.
generic.In-scope period: From annuity issuance until the schedule is booked and the annual review is diarised.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Amounts, frequency, start and end dates, obligor, issuer and review activity are populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: The booked schedule total reconciles to the contract total guaranteed payout.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The annuity contract used to book the schedule is referenced with its issue date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Booking differences against the contract are logged and corrected before sign off.
generic.Test population: All structured settlements booked in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the booked schedule total differs from the contract guaranteed payout.
generic.Exception handling path: A discrepancy against the contract is corrected before the obligation is activated.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when amounts, dates, obligor and review activity are all recorded and reconciled.
generic.Evidence location: Obligation schedule in the payment system with the liability view in the ERP ledger.

steps.title: Enter each periodic payment from the contract into the payment system
sop: Read the periodic amounts, frequency, start and end dates from the contract
Enter each into the obligation schedule
Confirm no payment line is omitted
Done when every periodic payment line is entered
verify: Compare the entered lines with the contract schedule
Pass when every contract payment line appears in the schedule

steps.title: Record step-ups, deferred lump sums and guaranteed period
sop: Enter any step-up increases and their effective dates
Enter deferred lump sums with their payment dates
Record the guaranteed period on the obligation
Done when step-ups, lump sums and guarantee are recorded
verify: Compare these features with the contract terms
Pass when every contract feature appears on the obligation

steps.title: Record the obligor and the annuity issuer on the obligation
sop: Record the assignment company as the obligor
Record the annuity issuer as the paying carrier
Confirm both match the qualified assignment and contract
Done when obligor and issuer are recorded
verify: Compare the recorded parties with the assignment and contract
Pass when obligor and issuer match the executed documents

steps.title: Reconcile the booked schedule total to the contract payout
sop: Total the booked schedule across the full term
Compare it to the contract total guaranteed payout
Correct the schedule where the totals differ
Done when the booked total equals the contract payout
verify: Recompute the booked schedule total
Pass when the booked total reconciles to the contract guaranteed payout

steps.title: Reflect the obligation in the ERP ledger
sop: Confirm the obligation is reflected in the ERP liability or memorandum view
Confirm the annuity cost has already been expensed at funding
Record the ledger reference against the obligation
Done when the ledger treatment is confirmed and referenced
verify: Compare the ledger view with the booked obligation
Pass when the ledger treatment matches the booked obligation

steps.title: Set the annual review activity on the obligation
sop: Create the annual review activity to confirm issuer payments continue
Assign it to the structured settlement administration owner
State the checks to perform at each review
Done when the annual review activity is created and assigned
verify: Confirm an annual review activity exists on the obligation
Pass when the review is assigned with a recurring due date

generic.Defined scope/population: Selection of the funding carrier for the structured settlement annuity on this claim.
generic.In-scope period: From receipt of the quote comparison until the selected carrier and rationale are recorded.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Carrier name, panel status, rating, concentration check, quote reference and date are recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: The selected quote reference matches one of the quotes on the comparison sheet.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: The rating evidence and selection rationale are filed with the selection date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Selection of a non-lowest quote is logged with the documented justification.
generic.Test population: All structured settlement carrier selections in the review period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the selection lacks a rationale, quote reference or rating evidence.
generic.Exception handling path: A carrier breaching the concentration limit is excluded and an alternative selected.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Accepted when panel status, rating, concentration and rationale are all evidenced.
generic.Evidence location: Carrier selection record on the claim in Guidewire ClaimCenter with evidence in the repository.

steps.title: Confirm the carrier is on the approved life market list
sop: Open the approved life market list for structured settlements
Confirm the intended carrier appears on the list
Record the panel status on the selection record
Done when the panel status is confirmed and recorded
verify: Compare the selected carrier with the approved list
Pass when the selected carrier is on the approved list

steps.title: Confirm the carrier rating meets the minimum threshold
sop: Read the current financial strength rating for the carrier
Compare it to the minimum threshold at the selection date
File the rating evidence in the claim repository
Done when the rating check is completed and evidenced
verify: Read the filed rating evidence and the threshold
Pass when the carrier rating meets the minimum at selection date

steps.title: Confirm carrier exposure is within the concentration limit
sop: Read the current aggregate exposure to the carrier
Add the proposed annuity cost and compare to the concentration limit
Select an alternative carrier where the limit would be breached
Done when the concentration check is completed and recorded
verify: Recompute aggregate exposure including this placement
Pass when the total remains within the counterparty concentration limit

steps.title: Document why a non-lowest quote was selected
sop: Compare the selected quote cost to the lowest quote received
Where higher, document the rating, rated age or service justification
Store the justification with the comparison sheet
Done when any non-lowest selection carries a justification
verify: Compare the selected and lowest quote costs
Pass when a non-lowest selection carries a written justification

steps.title: Record the selected carrier, quote reference and date in ClaimCenter
sop: Record the carrier name, quote reference and selection date
Confirm the quote reference matches the comparison sheet
Save the selection record against the claim
Done when carrier, reference and date are recorded
verify: Compare the recorded reference with the comparison sheet
Pass when the selected quote reference appears on the comparison

steps.title: File the selection rationale in the claim repository
sop: Store the selection rationale, rating evidence and comparison sheet
Index them with the claim number and selection date
Link them to the structured settlement record
Done when the selection evidence set is stored and linked
verify: Retrieve the selection evidence from the settlement record
Pass when the rationale is filed with the quote reference and rating evidence
